verdict.rationale: Windmill documents scripts as reusable units that are composed into flows, which covers reusable modules that workflows call. There is no evidence that a flow can call another flow as a sub-workflow, and no detail on how shared modules are reused or versioned. Missing for 10: explicit flow-as-subflow (nested workflow) support, documentation of reuse/versioning of shared modules across workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compose reusable sub-workflows or modules that other workflows call

citations.quote: Scripts are turned into sharable UIs automatically, and can be composed together into flows or used into richer apps built with low-code.
An orchestrator for assembling these functions into efficient, low-latency flows, using either a low-code builder or YAML
